units.source_text: 当时，名人在世田谷的家占地二百六十坪，建筑面积八十坪，庭院比较窄小。

en.t: At that time, the Master's house in Setagaya stood on a plot of two hundred sixty tsubo, with a building area of eighty tsubo, and the garden was rather small.

units.source_text: 他说，想把这里卖掉，迁到庭院比这里大一点的地方去。

en.t: He said that he wanted to sell this place and move somewhere with a garden a little larger than this one.

units.source_text: 想和他谈谈家庭的事也不成，实际上他和夫人过着二人生活，如今已经不再收弟子了。

en.t: It was no use trying to talk with him about family matters; in fact, he and his wife were living by themselves, and by then he no longer took on disciples.
